section.title: What you can do
section.description: Work through the steps below at your own pace, or jump straight to whatever you need.

user.description: Three ways Mahakama gives you free, plain-language legal help for South Sudan & Uganda.

infoCard.title: Know your rights
infoCard.description: Mahakama turns laws and regulations into plain language anyone can understand — no law degree required.

assistant.title: Chat with an AI Legal Assistant
assistant.description: Ask any legal question and get clear answers in plain language, grounded in the law of South Sudan and Uganda.

uploadDocuments.title: Upload & Analyze Documents
uploadDocuments.description: Upload contracts, notices or court papers and get a simple breakdown of what they mean for you.

exploreResources.title: Find Local Documents & Services
exploreResources.description: Browse laws and regulations from South Sudan and Uganda, or discover legal services near you.

lawyer.description: Everything you need to serve your clients with Mahakama — from client conversations to research.

infoCard.title: Grow your practice
infoCard.description: Find new clients, answer their questions and stay on top of the law with plain-language tools built for lawyers.

clientChats.title: Respond to client chats
clientChats.description: Answer legal questions from clients directly in chat, with answers grounded in the law of South Sudan and Uganda.

consultations.title: Review consultation requests
consultations.description: Receive, accept or decline consultation requests from people who need your expertise.

research.title: Research the legal database
research.description: Browse laws and regulations from South Sudan and Uganda to back your advice with the source law.

footer.summaryDescription: Mahakama offers general legal information, not legal advice. For decisions about your specific situation, consider consulting a qualified lawyer.
